description: The collision windows against the exact value (REQ-COL-060; colour_composition §6, the conditioning-aware scale; RQ-623): the collision input's windows with the payload's K₀ and V₀ the f64 decodeOnly()'s at each sample's point, rounded to f32. Every f32 evaluation misses them by about κ·eps beside a collision, on every backend, so this shows the conditioned worst flat under refinement where the fragment and the decode stage compile alike (lavapipe); it stays within the tolerance at every depth.
